notes.title: Fruit Hunter V1.2 Release 2021-10-01
notes.content:
[h3][u]New Features[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Visible leaderboard statistics
[*] Added a new fruit
[*] Added messages inside levels to inform players of game functionalities and tips
[*] Added 5 new levels
[/list]
[h3][u]Reworks[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed bow behavior to remove the ability to fire an arrow instantaneously
[*] Reworked apple behavior to be less suicidal and more happy and bouncy
[*] Small tweaks to banana behavior, animation and hitbox (for all of you that thought the bananas were to hard to hit)
[*] Player collision against objects has been improved to now be against every triangle. Yes, you will now be able to walk on every object.
[*] Levels will now be unlocked when clearing the previous levels, with or without any medals
[/list]
[h3][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug of arrow not firing in the direction of the player
[*] Fixed delta time not updating appropriately when switching between different game screens
[/list]

[h3][u]Notes[/u][/h3]
Here again with the second update for the game! And with it comes the long due leaderboard update which makes the leaderboards visible inside the game. But this is of course not the only new content, as a total of 5 new levels and a crazy new fruit have been added. Unfortunately all of the player files and leaderboard statistics will be reset, as tweaks to the overall game has impacted the playtime of the previous levels. As of this reset, we would like to thank all the dedicated players that actually reached the top of the leaderboards! Shout out to the top 5 players in Fruit Hunter:
[olist]
[*] Segallion
[*] Evjm12
[*] Trollcrap
[*] Hirajka
[*] suhnee
[/olist]
Well done and thank you for playing.

notes.title: Fruit Hunter V1.1 Release 2021-05-30
notes.content:
[h3][u]New Features[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added steam leaderboards (may view leaderboards in Community Hub)
[/list]
[h3][u]Reworks[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]Level select displays personal best time achieved
[*]Added button in level select screen to view controls
[*]Reworked banana behavior (shouldn't jump into water all the time)
[*]Small tweaks to melon behavior
[/list]
[h3][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug of player respawning in invalid positions
[*]Removed bug of dropping caught fruit
[/list]
[h3][u]Notes[/u][/h3]
This patch will sadly reset your progress in the game but a system is in place to stop this from happening in the future. There isn't currently any way to view the leaderboard ingame but this will be added in a future update.

Now enjoy the update and compete to get the best score in the leaderboard.
